nodes.default_value: The four frontier categories should be reported wherever the network implicates the corresponding flow, even when the characterisation factors are highly uncertain (D4.1 §10.3.5): (1) marine litter and plastic leakage; (2) biochar and soil carbon sequestration; (3) indirect land-use change (iLUC), which should be treated as mandatory for any high-TRL bio-based assessment; (4) microplastic fibre shedding in textile loops, where synthetic-fibre recycling must not be claimed as net-positive on GWP alone. For each, state the method version and whether the factor is built into the software or entered manually, and give results with uncertainty intervals. A category left out should appear in the interpretation as an explicit known blind spot, not a silent zero. Biodiversity loss is not one of the four: D4.1 Part 2 §9.1 lists it among under-assessed categories for agri-food and biorefineries.
